description: Bars 1 and 2 play only the main hits: Oilcan 1 plays MIDI 36 on steps 1 and 9 and MIDI 37 on steps 5 and 13, all at velocity 90. Bars 3 and 4 add one quiet hit, MIDI 38 at velocity 35, on step 12 of each bar, one step before the MIDI 37 accent. MIDI 38 is a different pad of the Oilcan kit, so the ghost note is both softer and a different drum sound than the main hits. 90 BPM, all notes half a step long. Listen for the soft extra hit that appears in the third bar, about 5 seconds in; it is much quieter than the main hits and the main hits do not change. Build it with the Make the recorded ghost-note comparison recipe.
synchronization: Observed framebuffer/grid sampled against host monotonic recording time; not sample-exact or physical-norns calibration.
title: Adding a Ghost Note
